scale_estimate.method: Affine block-count projection from measured Gate5 labels/active rows; unchanged topology, policy OFF. NOT a built or solved 3h model.
limitations: Variable label slots may include masked labels; compare to active Gate5 total.
Fine-step inflow/spill masks and active bounds can differ from daily means.
State equations and annual-sum rows have different time structure; nnz reference is not an exact count.
Future policy attribution/constraint choices may add terms.
